281. (Currently amended) A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers and at least two adhesive layers, the tool comprising first and second layers, a first adhesive layer configured to be cured on the first layer, a second adhesive layer configured to be cured on the second layer, the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer configured to be cured __directly__ to each other, the tool has a circular shape and includes a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers, a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are __aligned with each other and with__ the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer.

282. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

283. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 282 wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

284. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section is a composite material.

285. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 further including a weld ring __interposed between the plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments and the outer perimeter of the first and second layers__, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

286. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

287. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is continuous.

288. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring extends continuously around substantially an entire perimeter of the tool.

289. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is segmented.

290. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 further including an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring.

291. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 290 wherein the inner ring includes __a__ central opening.

293. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 further including a weld ring interposed between the plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments and the first and second layers, such that the plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring.

294. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 293 wherein the weld ring is continuous.

295. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 293 wherein the weld ring is segmented.
